control_question: Which public claim, codebase, device, standard, testbed, or fabrication route can close a system seam now, and what receipt keeps it replaceable?

coverage.control_question: Which lane converts each public mechanism into the next closed artifact without waiting for the originating actor to complete the system?

doctrine.admission_rule: A lane may consume a commodity only through a pinned identity, a named system gap, an explicit first transaction, and a receipt that preserves replacement.
doctrine.exit_rule: A lane remains valid when any actor or implementation can be removed without changing workload identity, accepted output, fallback behavior, or historical evidence.
doctrine.statement: The program decomposes the public frontier into concurrent completion lanes. External actors supply interchangeable artifacts, and the programme retains authority over accepted work, fallback, receipts, and succession.

lanes.control_question: Which claimed physical advantage survives the identical accepted workload, fallback, and complete system boundary?
lanes.first_transaction: Execute one fixed probabilistic or reversible workload through every available software baseline and emit the physical recovery or sampling conditions required for parity.
lanes.mission: Turn reversible, adiabatic, stochastic, and probabilistic mechanisms into workload-bound strategy and break-even evidence without allowing a device claim to define the workload.

lanes.control_question: Can the same continuous-time model and accepted event result survive every backend-specific discretization and mapping?
lanes.first_transaction: Run one immutable NIR graph and event dataset across two remote systems, one commercial backend, and a software fallback with first-divergence evidence.
lanes.mission: Make neuromorphic models, event streams, remote systems, and commercial chips interchangeable behind explicit continuous-time, discretization, mapping, and accepted-output contracts.

lanes.control_question: What transformation did the physical world perform beyond sensing, and what acquisition and readout work did the complete system pay?
lanes.first_transaction: Qualify one environmental or molecular trajectory against raw input and a pinned digital fallback under the same held-out assay.
lanes.mission: Admit environmental, embodied, molecular, and reservoir dynamics only when held-out task gain, calibration, readout, and full acquisition cost prove useful computation.

lanes.control_question: Which compiler transformations preserve information effects, accepted output, state custody, and source provenance?
lanes.first_transaction: Lower one reversible region and one physical-cartridge queue kernel through two compiler paths and prove equivalent RISC-V behavior.
lanes.mission: Use ordinary RISC-V as the portable control and provenance plane while consuming compiler, generator, and verification communities as replaceable implementation machinery.

lanes.control_question: Where does the model stop, which physical behavior replaces it, and how is divergence measured?
lanes.first_transaction: Build a coupled electrical, thermal, and physical cartridge model with shared time custody and two independent solver routes.
lanes.mission: Join circuit, compact-device, electromagnetic, thermal, mechanical, and fluid models through pinned interfaces without allowing simulated energy or fidelity to become measured truth.

lanes.control_question: Does useful delivered traffic still win after lasers, SerDes, package, retry, control, and cooling enter the receipt?
lanes.first_transaction: Express one accepted traffic pattern through an electrical baseline and two photonic cartridge models, then fabricate the smallest measurable structure.
lanes.mission: Consume photonic fabrics, optical I/O, open photonic PDKs, simulators, foundries, and metrology as competing data-movement cartridges.

lanes.control_question: Can a die or link implementation be replaced without changing the workload, state, security, or measurement contract?
lanes.first_transaction: Create one substrate-neutral chiplet package model that can switch among UCIe, CXL, and OpenHBI transport profiles.
lanes.mission: Make die-to-die links, coherent fabrics, package models, and chiplet architectures interchangeable while preserving cartridge lifecycle, security, and system receipts.

lanes.control_question: Which route can reproduce the same accepted design after a tool, PDK, facility, or programme disappears?
lanes.first_transaction: Build the cartridge control plane in two open PDKs and prepare one digital, one mixed-signal, and one photonic fabrication package.
lanes.mission: Maintain multiple reproducible routes from RTL and mixed-signal models to fabrication, packaging, and measured silicon without any foundry or flow becoming authority.

lanes.control_question: Can an external laboratory reproduce the same accepted result and synchronized complete-system measurement?
lanes.first_transaction: Join MLCFlow automation, PTDaemon telemetry, semantic result checks, and EVP qualification for one RISC-V target run.
lanes.mission: Bind workload, semantic result, power, temperature, time, instruments, uncertainty, automation, and independent acceptance into one reconstructable run.

lanes.control_question: Who can independently prove what ran, what measured it, and what superseded it after a vendor or programme exits?
lanes.first_transaction: Produce a signed source-to-GDS-to-measurement provenance chain and reconstruct it without the original builder.
lanes.mission: Attest source, firmware, calibration, models, builds, measurements, and supersession while keeping security components subordinate to workload authority.

lanes.control_question: Which execution strategy delivers the most accepted work after failures, retries, storage, sensing, and harvested energy are reconciled?
lanes.first_transaction: Replay one workload under a pinned energy trace across checkpoint, task-atomic, reversible-history, and cartridge execution.
lanes.mission: Compare reversible, checkpointed, task-atomic, and retry execution under identical energy traces and complete acquisition boundaries.

lanes.control_question: Can the project survive denial, delay, cancellation, or replacement of any external venue without losing evidence or progress?
lanes.first_transaction: Package one workload so it can move among two remote compute systems and two fabrication or measurement venues without changing acceptance.
lanes.mission: Treat remote systems, national facilities, research programmes, and public communities as replaceable execution venues whose access and failure are part of the evidence.
